verdict.rationale: Mercury Books documents in-product invites for a bookkeeper or accountant with "permissions tailored to their role" and unlimited advisor seats. Invited accountants can view transactions and categorizations and comment on them. The evidence does not show that invited accountants can adjust the books (for example, post journal entries, recategorize, or close periods), and it does not describe the role-permission tiers. missing for 10: documented edit/adjust rights for invited accountants, detail on the available role-scoped permission levels, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can invite my external accountant or bookkeeper with role-scoped access to review and adjust the books
